main_text.p: super quibus jugularentur victimæ, alludi porest, vel ad ipsum Idolum . nam & ea {*}sanguine victimarum oblinere solitos docet Sharestanius, accessurum inde opibus suis incrementum sperantes. Porrò نصب Nasb, vel Nosb, ut & literis & sensu cum נצב & מצבה convenit, ita significatione optimè respondet voci Hebraicæ עצב cum utrumque, & Idolum denotet & Molestiam, seu dolorem الشر والبلا i.e. malum & miseriam, quæ cultoribus suis abunde creant.* كادوا انا يدعوا للاصنام لطخوها دنما الهما يايلتمون بسن لك الرياة في امواهم

His addi possunt & alia ejusmodi terricula, qualia الشارف Alsharek, à quo cognominatus بن الشارف Abdol Sharek, filius Abdil Uzza, q. d. Cultor Shareki & مناف Manaf, à quo عبد مناف Abd Manaf, q. d Cultor Manafi, cui & filius عبد شمس Abd Shams, i. e. Cultor Solis. Ita enim من الشمس i.e. à Sole qui in cœlis lucet dictum monet AlFirauzabadius,AlFirauz quod eum sc. colerent è quibus ille oriundus: cùm tamen aliàs شمس Shams nomen fuisse * Idoli anti-v.sup.p.50. & 51. quod & 4ti regum Tamanens. nomé p.57.[illegible, ~3 letters] quitus culti doceat idem, quod Safioddinus شمس بضم واوه * Shoms vocat, cui fanum apud Bani Tamim dedica-tum. Num Solis forsan effigies?[?] Eidem Abdol Ma-nafo frater (ut vidimus) & tribus pater, عبد الدار Abdol Dar à دار Dar, Idolo: ab eodem themate دوار Dowar & Casba & Idoli nomen apud AlFiran-zmadium[?]. In serie regum Ierbumidarum عبد بالیل Abd Talil, & عبد مدان Abd Madan, habuimus, il-lum ab بالیل Talilo. Abd Talil f. عبد كلال Abd Colali. hunc à مدان Madano Idolis. اوال Awal, ut idolum tribubus Becr & Taglab peculiare memorat Alfirauxabadius, AlFirauz, ذو الكعبين Dul Caffain ut tribui Dus, (quem Safioddinus, Caffain, omisso Da vocat) باجر Bajar vel Bajer, ab Aedenfi-bus cultum perhibent idem & Ebnol Athir. الاقیصر AlOkaisar,

page.notes: Lower part of the page is not included in this image; the paragraph ends at "anti-" and continues on the next part. Doubtful readings: the Arabic in the right margin (first note block) is read letter by letter with uncertainty and may contain errors; the Arabic words in the text (نصب, الشر والبلا, الشارف, شمس) and the Hebrew נצב, מצבה and עצב should be checked against the scan. The small asterisk in the text after "ea" and the asterisk in the margin are taken to be the same mark. The bottom margin Arabic line is partly unreadable. The word "Sharestanius" is kept as printed. Arabic words in the column and margin are copied as far as legible; the vowel points and final letters of some names are doubtful. The colon-like mark after "effigies" and the spelling "AlFiran-zmadium" are uncertain. The note "بضم واوه" and the margin names are read from a small, faint print. "Aedenfi-" may read "Aedensi-".
